title: pCloud Confirms Password Manager Security Breach
excerpt: The pCloud Pass password manager has experienced a cyberattack following reports from users about strange account login attempts.
body_html:
The pCloud Pass password manager has experienced a security breach. The incident came to light after users noticed that unknown devices had managed to connect to their accounts.

Reports of these unauthorized connections occurred even when two-factor authentication was turned on.

Following user alerts regarding suspicious login activity, the company confirmed that the cyberattack took place.
